events.quote: In October 1939 , Almgren was appointed assistant military attaché in Tallinn , Riga , and Kaunas

events.text: The Soviet Union invasion ended his ability to act as attaché.

events.quote: The Soviet Union invasion in 1940 ended his ability to act as attaché

events.text: Almgren attended the Royal Swedish Army Staff College.

events.text: Almgren became a teacher at the newly established Swedish National Defence College.

events.text: Almgren's teaching at the Swedish National Defence College ended.

events.text: Almgren took office as Chief of the Army.

events.quote: Almgren took office as Chief of the Army on 1 October 1969

events.text: Almgren served as Chief of the Army until 1976.
